title: ISC2 Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP)
releaseBlockers: about 35 concepts rest only on ISC2's outline or on SP 800-97, which NIST withdrew on 31 December 2025: find current open sources or drop them
bus, star, ring and mesh topologies and machine-learning indicators of compromise have no open source yet, so the deck does not teach them
description: ISC2 SSCP: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
notice: ISC2, SSCP, CC and CBK are registered marks of ISC2, Inc. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by ISC2, Inc. It contains no ISC2 exam content and is not built from ISC2 study materials.

glossary.AU: the Audit and Accountability family of NIST SP 800-53 controls
glossary.HIPAA: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act

checks.what: Three independent audits read all 1084 cards: those quoting NIST publications against their quotes, found word for word by the card checker, and those written in our own words (the ISC2 outline and ethics code, IETF RFCs, MITRE ATT&CK) against their sources; every key length, block size, security strength and port number was checked
checks.result: One wrong card fixed (a maximum password length given as 64 characters, where SP 800-63B-4 says at least 64); 37 cards that repeated ISC2 CC cards deleted; an accounting primer added; 7 ambiguous cards, 4 unsupported claims and 20 unclear cards fixed, and 5 primers re-sourced.
